thread:
rachel_swe: Heads up — quota dashboard shows spike in 'unknown-tenant' usage for model=rw-instruct at ~23:10 UTC. alerts fired. dash: https://console.redwood.ai/d/quotas/usage

owen_product: that's odd, which alert? is it the tenant-exhausted rule?

quota-bot: Alert: tenant-exhausted triggered for rule=tenant-exhausted threshold=90% window=5m timestamp=1715023100

rachel_swe: Yes. The tenants page shows most of that traffic as 'unknown' not our usual org ids.

ben_infra: Did anything change in ingress or SDK headers? We route by header x-org-id to quota service.

kelly_devex: I shipped ts-sdk 2.4.0 this morning with a change: we normalized header casing to lower-case and introduced `x-rw-org` (short key) to reduce length in some environments. Old header `x-org-id` is still in docs but not emitted by default now unless compat flag set.

owen_product: so quota service only looks for `x-org-id` and falls back to unknown -> triggers tenant-exhausted alert. yikes.

ben_infra: Quick mitigation: add a passthrough in edge-proxy to copy x-rw-org -> x-org-id when missing. I'll roll a patch.

rachel_swe: also need to silence the pager while we fix attribution to avoid noise. can we mute the alert for 30m?

ci-bot: Incident mute applied by ben_infra for 30 minutes to rule=tenant-exhausted

kelly_devex: I'll cut a tiny patch for the TS SDK to emit both headers for a 1-week overlap and add a prominent note in release notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ts-sdk/pull/1199

ben_infra: Patch ready for proxy:
```yaml
# edge-proxy transform
headers:
  - if: not request.headers['x-org-id'] and request.headers['x-rw-org']
    set: { 'x-org-id': request.headers['x-rw-org'] }
```
Pushing canary to us-central.

ci-bot: Canary deployment started service=edge-proxy region=us-central user=ben_infra

ci-bot: Canary deployment succeeded service=edge-proxy region=us-central rev=7a1b2c3

rachel_swe: confirmed drop in unknown-tenant traffic after canary live. good.

owen_product: Long-term we can't keep both headers forever. plan: 1) emit both for 7 days 2) update quota service to accept x-rw-org as valid key 3) schedule deprecation notice and telemetry test 4) add integ test to exclude header-casing regressions. ticket: https://redwood.ai/issue/RW-1342

kelly_devex: I'll add opt-in compat flag in SDK: `{ compatHeaders: true }` and call it out in migration guide. Also add a console smoke test that runs on new releases to check quota attribution for a synthetic org id.

ben_infra: I'll update quota service to natively support `x-rw-org` and `x-org-id` and add tests in the metrics pipeline to assert counts per-tenant don't decrease unexpectedly.

rachel_swe: Can we also annotate the quota dashboard for the spike window (2024-04-26 23:05-23:30 UTC) so product/data people know it was header migration noise?

owen_product: Please do. And schedule a short email to customers on the deprecation timeline once we decide.

kelly_devex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ts-sdk/pull/1199 (shim + migration guide). Will link QA checklist and smoke test.

ben_infra: Follow-ups: proxy shim merged, quota service change queued in next deploy, alert mute expired. Closing loop once SDK patch is out and quota counts reconciled.

rachel_swe: Thanks everyone. Lesson: subtle header/key changes break downstream attribution; add a checklist for header compatibility before client SDK releases. :memo:
